provenance.revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: isolated production prop for a side-view 2D exploration platformer

Primary request: Create exactly one tall grounded funerary brazier for the Catacombs foreground.

Scene/backdrop: No depicted environment. Use a genuinely transparent background with clean alpha edges.

Subject: One connected prop only: a narrow, worn stone pedestal supporting a compact iron-and-bone brazier bowl, containing one restrained cold blue ghost flame, with one small skull ornament integrated into the brazier. The base is broad enough to read as firmly grounded. Keep the complete object immediately recognizable at small gameplay scale.

Style/medium: Crisp hand-authored 16-bit pixel art. Deliberate chunky pixel clusters, strong readable silhouette, hard pixel edges, limited palette, no painterly blur, no smoothing, and no antialiasing. Dark navy and indigo stone; desaturated blue-purple metal; restrained pale blue bone and flame highlights.

Composition/framing: Full object visible and centered on a portrait 1:2 composition canvas. Orthographic front view with slight three-quarter depth. Tall 1:2 subject silhouette with generous transparent padding on all sides. Grounded base aligned at the bottom of the subject bounds. No cropped pixels.

Lighting/mood: Cold subterranean light from the upper left. Solemn, ancient, and subdued, not bright or overtly magical.

Materials/textures: Chipped and worn stone pedestal, aged iron-and-bone bowl, compact integrated skull ornament. Pixel-cluster texture only.

Constraints: Generate exactly one isolated connected funerary brazier prop. Exactly one restrained attached ghost flame, with no detached pieces. Preserve actual background transparency and alpha. No checkerboard. No scenery, floor plane, ground, wall, arch, fog, cast shadow beyond the base, text, UI, border, frame, watermark, duplicate object, sparks, or detached flame fragments. No additional objects.
